changeSet.author: pos
changeSet.comment: Drop FK from sales/inventory product_id columns to products (catalog extract prep)
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE r RECORD; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT c.conname AS constraint_name, rel.relname AS table_name FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class rel ON rel.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = rel.relnamespace JOIN pg_class ref ON ref.oid = c.confrelid WHERE c.contype = 'f' AND nsp.nspname = current_schema() AND ref.relname = 'products' AND rel.relname IN ( 'sale_items', 'store_stock', 'stock_movements', 'stock_lots', 'stock_receipt_lines', 'stock_transfer_lines', 'stock_inventory_lines', 'stock_expense_lines', 'stock_production_lines', 'stock_productions' ) LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I DROP CONSTRAINT %I', r.table_name, r.constraint_name); END LOOP; END $$;
